mechanism_claims.limitations: Not coded as direct_mechanism because the cited mechanism is contextual literature background rather than a paper-local direct assay.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: The source-review supports a structure-activity relationship: fatty-acid chain length and acylation position correlate with antimicrobial activity and hemolysis across the lipopeptide panel.
mechanism_claims.limitations: Association is based on activity/toxicity profiling, not a molecular target assay.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: Tomato defense-gene expression was tested as host-response context; only selected peptides showed limited overexpression, so this remains host-response evidence rather than antimicrobial killing mechanism evidence.
mechanism_claims.entity_scope: selected BP100-derived lipopeptides in tomato plants
